{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= File:BotW Reinforced Lizal Shield Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Reinforced Lizal Shield Model.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Reinforced Lizal Shield Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Reinforced Lizal Shield Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Defense |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 22 |TotK= 22 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 12 |TotK= 12 }} |comp= {{List| * [[Lizal Shield]] * [[Steel Lizal Shield]] }} |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Reinforced Lizal Shield|Reinforced Lizal Shields|Series, BotW|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}} Reinforced Lizal Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 22 |durability = 12 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Reinforced Lizal Shield}} Reinforced Lizal Shields are [[Lizal Shield]]s that have been strengthened with the addition of a different type of metal. Their edges are lined with spikes, which means they must be handled with care. [[Blue Lizalfos]] commonly use these Shields, though [[Fire-Breath Lizalfos]], [[Ice-Breath Lizalfos]], and [[Electric Lizalfos]] may also use them. They belong to the [[Lizalfos Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created and utilized by [[Lizalfos]]. Being made of metal, Reinforced Lizal Shields will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. However, they can be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] basic [[Rune]], and they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_008" |Life = 12 |GuardPower = 22 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 3 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 12 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 22 |durability = 12 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Reinforced Lizal Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Reinforced Lizal Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Reinforced Lizal Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Lizal Forked Boomerang]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Lizalfos Gear * Lizal Shield * Shield * Steel Lizal Shield }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Reinforced Lizal Shield}}
